names.pt-BR: Arautos de Ashur — A Máscara de Cinzas
names.en: Harbingers of Ashur — The Ashen Mask

pt-BR.title: Linhagem
pt-BR.text:
Os Capadócios, donos do rancor mais antigo da Jyhad, eram o Clã da Morte antes da usurpação Giovanni. Considerados destruídos por séculos, teriam adotado máscaras e o nome Arautos das Caveiras; outra versão diz que uma facção já usava o nome Arautos gerações antes. A maioria se juntou ao Sabá e combateu os interesses Giovanni. Durante anos, parecia que só a aniquilação de um lado encerraria o conflito, até a Reunião da Família.

Apesar da reconciliação e do reconhecimento dos Capadócios remanescentes, os Arautos das Caveiras não podiam continuar como antes; tampouco os Capadócios podiam voltar ao passado após séculos de ira. Respondem a ambos os nomes, mas são uma síntese dos dois. A forma antiga morreu e fertilizou a terra para algo novo crescer.

pt-BR.title: A Máscara de Cinzas
pt-BR.text: Você usa uma máscara simples de freixo: respeita a tradição dos Arautos, mas valoriza o estudo da morte acima de status, glória e vingança. Se um Pilar seu já estiver morto ou morrer após adquirir este benefício, estudar o cadáver permite transferir a Convicção que ele representa para outro mortal como se tivesse morrido em paz. Se realmente morreu em paz, receba um dado adicional no teste de Humanidade. Se outra pessoa interferir com o cadáver, teste contra Frenesi de Fúria com dificuldade 3.

pt-BR.title: Compra e uso
pt-BR.text: Cada benefício é independente: pague seu valor completo em pontos, ou 3 XP por ponto durante o jogo com aprovação do Narrador. Não exige nem concede os níveis inferiores. Você pode ter uma Linhagem de Sangue e uma Ficha de Conhecimento comum. Efeitos de cena, personagens coadjuvantes e concessões narrativas são resolvidos com o Narrador.

en.title: Bloodline
en.text:
Holding the Jyhad’s longest grudge, the Cappadocians were the Clan of Death before they were usurped by the upstart Giovanni. Believed for centuries to be destroyed, the Cappadocians either took to wearing masks and calling themselves the “Harbingers of Skulls” or a subfaction of the clan named themselves “Harbingers” generations before. Whatever the truth, the majority joined the Sabbat and worked aggressively against Giovanni interests. For many years it was thought that both sides would never stop until one obliterated

the other, but that appears to have changed with the Family Reunion. Despite the reconciliation and the acknowledgment of the remnants of the Cappadocian Kindred, the Harbingers of Skulls as they were could no longer exist. But neither could the Cappadocians return to their former state after so many centuries of anger. As such, these vampires respond to either name, but they have become some synthesis of the two. Like all things, the past form has died, and enriched the earth so that something new can grow.

en.title: The Ashen Mask
en.text: You don a plain mask made of ash wood, for while you respect the traditions of the Harbingers, you care more about studying death than status, glory, or revenge. If a Touchstone of yours is dead or dies after you purchase this lore, study of their corpse allows you to transfer the Conviction they represent to another mortal (Vampire: The Masquerade, p. 240) as if they died peacefully. If they actually did, gain a one-die bonus to the Humanity test. If anybody else interferes with the corpse, you must test against fury frenzy at Difficulty 3.

en.title: Purchase and use
en.text: Each benefit is independent: pay its full dot rating, or 3 XP per dot during play with Storyteller approval. It neither requires nor grants lower ranks. You may have one Bloodline and one ordinary Loresheet. Resolve scene effects, supporting characters and narrative grants with the Storyteller.

en.text: You don the mask engraved in the image of one of the clan founders, for you know the true secret of the Harbingers. Their crusade was never solely about destroying the Giovanni, but annihilating all those who serve the Clan of Death. The final stage of necromancy is for all who practice it to die, and become the masters of death. You incur no stains for any action taken in the pursuit of killing another Hecata Kindred, or any character who serves the Hecata.

en.title: Purchase and use
en.text: Each benefit is independent: pay its full dot rating, or 3 XP per dot during play with Storyteller approval. It neither requires nor grants lower ranks. You may have one Bloodline and one ordinary Loresheet. Resolve scene effects, supporting characters and narrative grants with the Storyteller.
